spans.s:
tirás,
 —1. prep. through; across;
 —2. as
adv. crossways, sideways; aside; w. kṛ
[171^3, 1078^4], put aside, treat disrespectfully,
 scold. [√tṛ, ‘cross’: cf. Lat. trans,
‘across.’]

tiryaktva, n. condition of a beast.
[tiryak, middle stem of tiryañc, 1249a:
1239.]

tīra, n. shore or bank. [prop. ‘place of
crossing or going into the water,’ √tṛ.]
